blocks.text: Parathyroid glands thyroid ki pichli sateh par chaar chhote glands hain. Jab khoon ka calcium girta hai to yeh parathormone chhorte hain. Parathormone osteoclasts (haddi ke cells) se haddi ke matrix ke calcium crystals ghulwa kar calcium khoon mein chhurwata hai, gurdon se peshab ka calcium wapas jazb karwata hai, aur vitamin D ko faal karta hai jo aant mein khurak se calcium jazb karne ke liye zaroori hai.

blocks.caption: Parathormone ka adam tawazun
rows: haddiyon se zyada calcium nikalta, woh naram aur tedhi ho jati; khoon ka calcium barhta (hypercalcaemia), nervous system dab jata aur muscles kamzor
hypocalcaemia: neurons zyada hassas; tetany jis mein muscles sukre rehte hain

blocks.prompt: Parathormone aur calcitonin ke asraat ulte hain. Wazahat kijiye.
blocks.explanation: Parathormone khoon ka calcium barhata hai (haddi se calcium bahar, peshab se wapas, aant mein zyada jazb); calcitonin calcium ko haddi mein le ja kar use kam karta hai.

items: Chaar parathyroids; parathormone khoon ka calcium barhata (haddi, gurde, vitamin D). Zyada: naram haddiyan, hypercalcaemia; kam: hypocalcaemia, tetany.
